facts.text: 44,049 advance ballots cast Oct. 6-11, a Mississauga advance-voting record
Oct. 11 busiest advance day with 12,335 ballots
Election day Monday Oct. 26, 9 a.m. to 8 p.m.
Parrish is sitting mayor, Crombie former mayor, Tedjo and Damerla sitting councillors running for mayor
Mid-August Liaison poll: Parrish and Crombie tied at 26, Damerla 13, Tedjo 9, 26 undecided
End-of-September Mainstreet poll had Crombie top with others slightly behind
Front-runners prioritize affordability, crime and transportation; Damerla also City Hall accountability
Living Arts Centre: Crombie would cancel redevelopment, Tedjo and Damerla oppose, Parrish backs it
Full Mainstreet numbers and certified candidate list not located
Advance turnout up 57 per cent over 2022's 28,052
Overall turnout 21.8 per cent in 2022, 26.5 in 2018, 25.7 in 2024 by-election
Ward-level advance breakdowns and final 2026 turnout not available
Voters choose mayor, city/regional councillor and school trustee

missed.text: Daily advance totals: Oct. 6 1,139; Oct. 7 948; Oct. 8 11,022; Oct. 9 9,147; Oct. 10 9,458
Other top advance sites: Erin Meadows 3,120 and Civic Centre 2,812; advance voters could use any location citywide
75 candidates across 11 ward races; nominations closed 2 p.m. Aug. 21
Liaison decided voters: Parrish 35, Crombie 35, Damerla 18, Tedjo 12
Crombie is a former Ontario Liberal leader; Parrish was elected in the 2024 by-election
Crombie calls the Living Arts Centre plan a "$2.5-billion vanity project"; Damerla wants a health care innovation district instead
